sources.excerpt: by Crazy Tube Circuits Website Link Model Number or Name: Pin Up Fuzz Fuzz Octave Circuit Type: Analog Electrical Components: MOSFET Transistor Original Price: $219 Excellent Used Price: $170 Year Released: 2013 Alternate Version(s) No Alternate Versions Listed A fuzz can be raw or smooth, raspy and spitty or clean… or it can be Pin Up. The gain range starts from overdrive to become a high gain fuzz, nasty or smooth depending on where you set the two interactive tone controls. The frequency response of this MOSFET fuzz machine has been carefully selected to fulfill your rhythm and soloing needs. Note definition is excellent, and yet it still retains that distortion box like articulation. Turn on the upper octave/ring mod for a percussive fuzz effect with aggressive-but-smooth pick attack and loads of sustain.
